failures.name: PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY_NOT_VERIFIED
failures.observation: A materialized heldout case became exportable after only changing benchmark_provenance.split to dev and training_eligible to true.
failures.risk: The export boundary trusts mutable case-local provenance instead of re-verifying partition authority against an immutable suite/manifest contract.
failures.repair_direction: Resolve partition authority from a trusted suite/manifest registry or signed/hashed provenance envelope at export time; reject local relabeling.

failures.name: UNPROVENANCED_OR_UNKNOWN_SPLIT_NOT_FAIL_CLOSED
failures.observation: A heldout case became exportable after provenance was stripped and a top-level split=dev was supplied; an unknown provenance split=train with training_eligible=true was also exportable.
failures.risk: Missing or non-allowlisted partition metadata can silently become training eligible.
failures.repair_direction: For S5 benchmark-origin rows require materialized provenance and an explicit allowlisted split resolved from the suite; remove permissive top-level fallback.

failures.name: MATERIALIZED_PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY_NOT_ENFORCED
failures.observation: A dev materialized case remained exportable after its prompt was mutated while the recorded source-case hash remained unchanged.
failures.risk: Source hashes document lineage but do not authenticate the payload actually entering training export.
failures.repair_direction: Bind a canonical materialized-payload digest to provenance and verify it immediately before export; fail closed on any mismatch.

failures.name: DECISION_EXEMPTION_SCHEMA_MATERIALIZER_DIVERGENCE
failures.observation: The materializer accepts a typed decision_contract_exemption without graph_eval, while the JSON schema still requires graph_eval at the root.
failures.risk: Different S5 interfaces disagree about what constitutes a valid case, making validation dependent on which code path is used.
failures.repair_direction: Encode one authoritative contract, e.g. JSON Schema oneOf graph_eval or typed exemption, and make materializer/validator consume the same rule.

non_failures: Baseline heldout and regression export guards passed before adversarial mutation.
Gold sentinel was not exposed in the model prompt.
Gold release gate correctly remained BLOCKED_GOLD_REVIEW.
repair_policy: Do not modify the first-observation metrics. Repair generically in a later version; reuse this v0.2 suite only as exposed regression thereafter.
